newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentina placed 250 mln peso, two-yr bond.
newsitem.headline: Argentina placed 250 mln peso, two-yr bond.

text.p: Argentina's Economy Ministry announced Monday it has placed a two-year bond of 250 million pesos in the international capital markets.
The bond carries a coupon of 8.75 percent.
Goldman Sachs International placed the issue. It was sold at par. The bond is a straight bullet issue. Interest will be paid every six months.
"This issue is part of the government's strategy of gradually developing a peso yield curve, which can be used as a reference point for the private sector," the Economy Ministry said in a release.
The financing raised through the issue is part of the financing requirement for next year.
